claim_reviewed: (i) exact ice projection of the adopted P31 V002 source gives a LINEAR shear insertion lambda=(2/9)(3Delta-4Ud)=2delta/3+16Ud/9 per A cell and a QUADRATIC diagonal-traceless insertion; (ii) in a Gaussian Coulomb phase the static connected shear response is (lambda^2/U_e) L^T Pi_T L, with Ward residue 2 lambda^2 k1k2k3/(U_e k^2), no CR (a,b,c,d) representation, nullity 8 (linear) or 6 (with diagonal block); (iii) lambda equal at rho=0,1 so chi ratio = U_e(0)/U_e(1).
verified: A8 vs normalized cosine A1 by central finite differences, 50 random X x 6 pairs: max abs error 1.5e-10 (c0=-1/3).
Eqs (1),(2),(3) exact for all 6 pairs x 20 random rational X; A_ab traceless.

Full lattice first source derivative of the Q0 diagonal H on periodic diamond L=2 (8 A, 32 edges) and L=3 (27 A, 108 edges), 40 ice configurations per (L, rho), rho in {0,1}, 6 coefficient tuples, dstar in {2,3,4}: equals trace owners + lambda X.P + (Ud/3) sum_v X_ii Q_v,i with residual exactly 0; sum_A e_A = sum_B e_B = sum_e n_e sigma_a every time, so A and B insertions add: lambda = 2Delta_can/3 - 8Ud/9 for any dstar.

Crosswalk identity Delta_can sum n + Ud sum(d-dstar)^2 = Ud sum(d-2)^2 + delta sum n + Nv Ud(dstar^2-4), delta=Delta_can+4Ud(2-dstar), on 200 configurations. Delta form lambda = 2delta/3 + (24 dstar - 56)Ud/9: at delta=0, Ud=1 gives -32/9, -8/9, 16/9, 40/9, 64/9 for dstar=1..5, so 16Ud/9 holds at dstar=3 (the packet's stated choice). Attaching the source to delta instead of Delta_can is wrong by exactly 8Ud/3, confirming the packet's warning.

Linear/quadratic split: local function space on 6 ice states = 1 + 3 (e, odd under n->1-n) + 2 (Q, even); shear entries exactly odd, diagonal entries exactly even. Uniform linear term is T2.T2 allowed and not forbidden by bond-centre inversion.
lambda is strictly positive inside the ice window: at dstar=3, |delta|<2Ud gives lambda in (4Ud/9, 28Ud/9). The fine-tuning Delta_can=4Ud/3 sits at x=-4/3, outside |x|<1.

(iii) at h^0: lattice residual 0 at both rho; eps_r and -lamR d q are trace-only owners. Exact O(h^2) shear vertex dE2/ds=-h^2 sum_e[2 l_e'/D_e - D_e'/D_e^2]: coefficient -8/9 (rho=0), -656/675 (rho=1) at Ud=1, Delta_can=4, dstar=3, lamR=1/4, eps_r=1/2; at h=1/10 lambda_eff=398/225 and 29836/16875, (lambda1/lambda0)^2=0.999062 (synthesizer re-derived from the stated coefficients).

(ii) Completing the square on the transverse space gives chi_lin=(lambda^2/U_e) L^T Pi_T L, independent of K_b and temperature; single-oscillator Kubo-Mori static susceptibility = 1/U exactly at beta=1,20,50,200, distinct from equal-time covariance (1/2)sqrt(K/U); packet correctly uses the static response.

Independent diamond Gaussian lattice model (U_e=U_b/4), direction [1,2,3]: max|chi-Pi_T/U_e| at q=0.4,0.1,0.025,0.00625 is 0.122, 0.0305, 0.00764, 0.00191 (A-site, ~k) and 7.76e-3, 4.85e-4, 3.03e-5, 1.89e-6 (A/B-averaged, ~k^2); Ward witness ratio -> 0.99999985 at q=0.00625; at exactly k=0 response is I/U_e, so the k->0 limit is direction dependent.

Eq (9) exact at 260/260 (check 4) and 200/200 (check 3) random rational k. All 9 (shear row, spatial xi) entries have nonzero remainder mod k^2 (e.g. 2k1k2k3 for row h12, xi=e3); temporal xi residue exactly 0.
Nullity 8 (linear block) and 6 (plus b(I-11^T/3) block) at every k tested (260/260 and 200/200); null space exactly span{h00,h01,h02,h03,trace,L^T k}; dim(null cap gauge span)=1.

CR non-membership: best (a,b,c,d) fit at |k|=1 is (0.340,-0.132,-0.164,0.055) with relative residual 0.644. Einstein + s*chi_lin: s=0 Ward residual 7.3e-15 nullity 4; s=1e-3 residual 2.70e-3 nullity 2; s=1 residual 3.15 nullity 2.

Connected vs 1PI: joint local chart (h, e, Gauss multiplier phi) Hessian polynomial in k; Schur complement = C - chi_lin in 53/53; joint Ward system has no solution for any (e,phi) transformation in 159/159 spatial-xi cases (random, zero, completed-square contacts); required phi shift -lambda(k.LN)/k^2 is nonlocal; Moore-Penrose inverse of chi_lin is (U_e/lambda^2) L^T Pi L (34/34) with the same nullity 8 and nonpolynomial residue. The Ward failure is chart independent at formal Gaussian order.
problems: Eq (5) is not exact as written. It gives the per-A-cell diagonal-traceless insertion as (2Ud/3) sum_i j_ii(e_i^2-4/3) with ONE vertex polarization, i.e. it assumes Q_A=Q_B. The exact form (lattice residual 0 in check 3) is (Ud/3) sum_i j_ii (Q_A,i+Q_B,i), Q_v,i=e_v,i^2-4/3. Synthesizer check (claude_p37_eq5_AB_quadrupole_check.py, 15 random diamond ice states, L=2,3,4): per-cell Q_A!=Q_B in 6-7/8, 17-22/27, 35-47/64 cells; even uniform-source totals differ (A vs B axis counts unequal in 14/15 states, e.g. L=2 A=(4,2,2), B=(4,0,4)), while linear totals sum_A e_A = sum_B e_B held 15/15. Section 7 calls (1)-(5) exact microscopic identities. No verdict changes: the quadratic block uses the declared matching mu and nullity 6 needs only mu!=0.

Eq (10) holds at order h^0 only. Virtual-flip corrections to the shear vertex depend on rho through denominators 2Ud+-(delta-2 lamR rho) (values in verified item 7), so chi1/chi0 = [U_e(0)/U_e(1)]*[1+O(h^2/Ud^2)]; it also needs both endpoints in the window, max(|x0|,|x0-r|)<1. Section 2 says corrections start at h^2, but eq (10) is stated 'on every nonzero common matrix entry' without the qualifier.

Fine-tuning caveat is imprecise: at dstar=3 the tuning Delta_can=4Ud/3 is at x=-4/3, outside the ice window, so lambda!=0 is established (not merely assumed) throughout |x|<1; at dstar=2 the tuning would lie inside (x=2/3). Harmless.

Null count is the weakest part of the argument. The 8/6 nulls are zero-response directions; only one (h0i=k_i, temporal xi) is a gauge direction, and in a Legendre picture they become infinitely stiff constraints, the opposite of gauge nulls. Rank only grows with subleading terms, so full-kernel nullity is <=8 (<=6) and unknown. A control adding hypothetical A1 (tr j e^2) and T2 (j_ij e_i e_j) matchings gives nullity exactly 4 (null space entirely temporal) with Ward residual >=0.38: a false 'exactly-4' pass. At O(h^0) those matchings are absent (|e_v|^2=4, e_v,i e_v,j=0 exactly), so 6 is right at the stated order. The packet already disclaims generic null counts; the Ward residue is the robust result and the null count should not be read as an independent Einstein test.

'Uncancellable' is relative to declared field content and the charge-free sector. Not ruled out: another gapless sector with nonlocal degree-0 exchange (e.g. a displacement/embedding field with delta u = xi, as in elastic media). With a nonzero density of mobile emergent charges (Debye scale k_D) chi = I/U - kk^T/[U(k^2+k_D^2)] is analytic for k<k_D and the argument must be redone; Born defects at rho1 must remain at zero density. The packet names extra gapless fields but not the charge-density condition.

Follow-up P37_FORMAL_JOINT_GAUSSIAN_LEGENDRE_CHART_V001.txt (outside this manifest): its 'would overstate' remark must not be read as weakening the obstruction; Gamma_hh at fixed y is only the h-only block, the joint identity fails exactly when connected F_hh fails, and for an external metric source F_hh=-W_hh already is the effective-action Hessian.

CR non-membership follows from homogeneity (degree 0 vs degree 2) and non-SO(3) covariance of d_ijk j_ij e_k, as the packet body argues; the handoff-level wording that links it to the Ward residue ('therefore') is not itself an inference.
Finite-k B-averaging form factors checked only in their k=0 constant limit (check 3); check 4's A/B-averaged lattice error ~k^2 is consistent with them affecting subleading terms only.

recommended_clarifications: State that lambda>0 throughout the ice window at dstar=3 (lambda in (4Ud/9, 28Ud/9)); the Delta_can=4Ud/3 tuning is outside it.
Present the Ward residue (9) as the primary result and the 8/6 null count as a property of the leading block only, not as a gauge-null count.
Add the zero-charge-density condition (no Debye screening; Born defects at rho1 at zero density) to the conditions under which (9) is uncancellable.
